name: Joy_1
short_caption: The robot opens its arms wide in a joyous and welcoming gesture before returning to its neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and brings both hands slightly inward and downward. It then sweeps both arms outward and upward in a wide, symmetrical arc with palms facing up, while lifting its head slightly. Finally, it smoothly retracts its arms and lowers its head, returning to the starting neutral position.
safety_notes: The robot sweeps both arms wide horizontally; ensure there are no obstacles or people directly to its left or right within arm's reach.
